verdict.rationale: Lambda offers Managed Slurm and Managed Kubernetes (MK8s) as first-party managed schedulers on top of 1-Click Clusters, with Slurm handling automatic job scheduling/utilization and daemon health monitoring, and MK8s providing preconfigured GPU/RDMA Kubernetes clusters ready for workload deployment — directly fulfilling the 'managed scheduler instead of building your own' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Slurm or K8s job scheduling in production (community evidence only covers billing and unofficial CLI tooling, not scheduler usage), and no detail on multi-tenancy/queue customization depth.
